$comment: Crackio's own feature and tool images, Director's stage pieces and the visual-vocabulary pickers, generated from these prompts with `pnpm assets:generate` (Codex CLI image tool). Re-run a single asset with `pnpm assets:generate feature-director`. The home page's hero, its prompt gallery and the Video card come from scripts/assets/home.mjs (hero.json, examples.json).
style: Photographic, cinematic color grade, natural film grain, rich contrast. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

assets.prompt: Behind-the-scenes photograph on a dark film sound stage: a young woman in a long rust-red wool coat stands on a fluorescent orange tape X mark on the black floor. A cinema camera on a dolly track sits soft-focus in the near foreground, framing her. A single tungsten fresnel backlight carves a warm rim of light through atmospheric haze. Deep shadows, anamorphic feel, wide composition with generous negative space on the left third.

A sculptural white sneaker floating above a seamless charcoal studio sweep, photographed as a dramatic three-quarter low-angle hero shot. Soft top light, one crisp warm-orange edge light along the sole, faint reflection on the floor. Premium product photography, razor sharp, wide composition with negative space on the left.

Close portrait of a man in his thirties with freckles and curly dark hair in a dark studio, lit by one hard light from camera left that draws a crisp Rembrandt triangle on his shadow-side cheek, plus a cool blue rim light from behind. Visible skin texture, shallow depth of field, subject placed on the right third, dark negative space on the left.

Overhead three-quarter view of a miniature film set built on a dark wooden table: tiny figurines standing on small orange tape marks, a miniature cinema camera on a tripod, tiny LED lamps casting warm pools of light. Tilt-shift depth of field, playful yet premium.
A vintage turquoise scooter photographed from a dramatic worm's-eye angle against a clean pale blue sky, strong converging perspective, crisp midday light, editorial magazine look.
Fine-art still life: a matte ceramic vase and three lemons on a stone table, lit by a single hard window light that throws long dramatic diagonal shadows, deep teal background.

Photoreal character turnaround of one original woman in her twenties with a short silver bob and a sage-green bomber jacket: front view, three-quarter view and profile view standing side by side on a neutral grey studio backdrop, identical face, hair and outfit in every view, even softbox lighting.

A sunlit minimalist living room with a mid-century tan leather armchair, a tall fiddle-leaf fig plant and a round brass mirror on a warm white wall, airy morning light, editorial interior photography.
A frosted glass perfume bottle with no label standing on a wet black river stone in a misty pine forest at dawn, soft volumetric light beams, dew drops, luxury product photography.
A contemporary dancer frozen mid-leap inside an empty concrete parking garage, harsh overhead fluorescent tubes, long shadows, high energy cinematic photograph.
Extreme macro photograph of a human eye with a hazel iris, every iris fiber and eyelash crisp, tiny window reflection in the pupil, studio light, hyper detailed.
An astronaut in a weathered white suit walking through a field of tall golden grass at sunset, wide establishing shot, epic scale, warm haze, film grain.
Full-body studio photo of a young woman in a long rust-red wool coat, black trousers and white sneakers, standing relaxed and facing the camera, isolated cutout.
A golden retriever sitting upright and looking slightly to the left, full body, isolated cutout, studio light.
A mid-century modern lounge chair in tan leather with walnut legs, three-quarter view, full object, isolated cutout, studio light.

An empty photo studio with a seamless light grey cyclorama wall and floor, two large softboxes at the edges, eye-level wide shot, no people.
